about: One prompt for `chatprompts --set chat-save.json`: a thing added and saved in one message, so that save with the draft's id comes after apply on the real chat. Same fields as chat-prompts.json.

prompts.text: put a golden squirrel near the village for us to find, switch it on, then save it
prompts.why: Save comes after apply in one message: the draft's own thing stands in the world by then, and it must not count against the draft.
